title: Language Models as Higher-Order Planning Formalizers
abstract: arXiv:2603.23844v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recent work provides overwhelming evidence that LLMs, even those trained to scale their reasoning trace, quickly deteriorate at planning as problems become more complex. LLM-as-Formalizers aim to address this by employing LLMs as a bridge to translate natural language descriptions into structured planning representations such as PDDL, which are then fed to a programmatic solver. We observe that its success may be overstated because planning problem descriptions in standard benchmarks often have a one-to-one mapping to PDDL, which departs from real use cases. To address this, we introduce the notion of unraveling problems where a natural yet succinct description translates into a very large PDDL representation. Using unraveling variants of four standard planning domains, we demonstrate that LLM Formalizers also do not always scale. translated_title: 语言模型作为高阶规划形式化器
translated_abstract: 近期的研究提供了压倒性的证据表明，即使是通过扩展推理轨迹进行训练的大语言模型（LLM），随着问题复杂度的增加，其在规划任务上的表现也会迅速恶化。LLM-as-Formalizers（LLM作为形式化器）方法旨在解决这一问题，其思路是将LLM作为桥梁，把自然语言描述翻译成结构化的规划表示（如PDDL），再将其输入给程序化求解器。我们观察到，这一方法的有效性可能被高估了，因为标准基准中的规划问题描述通常与PDDL存在一一对应的映射关系，这与真实使用场景相去甚远。为了解决这一问题，我们引入了“unraveling问题（展开式问题）”的概念，即一段自然且简洁的描述需要被翻译成非常庞大的PDDL表示。通过使用四个标准规划领域的unraveling变体，我们证明了LLM形式化器同样无法总是良好扩展。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种新范式——LLM-as-Higher-Order-Formalizer（LLM作为高阶形式化器），其中LLM……
tldr: 该论文指出LLM作为形式化器的成功在标准基准上被高估，并提出“展开式问题”这一新基准来揭示LLM形式化器在需要从简洁描述生成大规模PDDL时无法扩展，进而提出LLM作为高阶形式化器的新范式以应对这一挑战。
